body:
Saved games reset Warrush's construction/maintenance clocks and Numbi's phase clock, and omit decision state in Nicowar, Cabino and Cortex. Resuming a save can therefore change AI orders and the simulation. Preserve those clocks, explorer phases and full-width counters, Cabino specialist observations/cached fields/refresh order and complete queued-order envelopes, and Cortex's selected learned policy and weights. Direct runtime reloads replace existing pending work; named text records now decode correctly. Keep main's already-landed queue safety fixes.

Use save format 132 (128–131 were used by intervening changes) and protocol 54. The save floor stays 58 and replay floor stays 127. Older formats consume no appended fields and retain historical defaults; values omitted by old writers cannot be recovered. Fresh-game strategy and tuning remain unchanged. Cached continuation fields increase saved AI data.

Validation: optimized macOS/Apple LLVM native build with the pinned SDL3 prefix; 112 test cases passed, zero failed, and two display-only cases skipped (107 runner groups). Seven simulation-version contract tests also passed. The focused suites cover binary/text boundaries, genuine old records through 131, malformed data, wrappers, queues/caches/policies, and 110 checkpoints with 256 resumed ticks each, repeated reloads, mixed AIs and shared-team controllers. Existing JavaScript profile-two, Maxima, save/replay/network and farming regressions pass.

Simulation revision 9 isolates the corrected continuation behavior online. The multiplayer fixture retains its original setup, seed, orders, reports and events: only version metadata and the record CRC change. The original 702-tick checksum trace verifies unchanged. Linux execution and cross-platform continuation comparison were unavailable locally and are not claimed.

Accessible review evidence: [verification report](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/evidence/ai-save-state-929dafeb7/AIContinuationMergeVerification.txt) and [logs, checkpoint saves, per-tick traces and SHA-256 manifest](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/evidence/ai-save-state-929dafeb7/AIContinuationMergeEvidence.zip). The evidence branch keeps generated artifacts out of master.

Local / VM verification

- Tested source commit: `929dafeb7bf0dff65f73332885e6daccdbb62bf8`, integrated with master `dcc4d266a78def3e9414ddbfaad671aec2675816`; merged as `283d9ca42e32a3cb522aeba90d336b97a64fcac9`.
- Environment: native macOS arm64, Apple LLVM 21, 64-bit; pinned SDL3 dependency prefix. Optimized build: `GLOB2_SDL3_PREFIX=/Users/bradley/.cache/glob2-sdl3/prefix scons -j8 release=1 server=0 tests` (exit 0).
- Exact focused command (exit 0, 112 passed cases / 107 runner groups, two display-only cases skipped):

```sh
python3 test/run_tests.py --filter 'LegacyAIState/*' --filter 'AIStateContinuation/*' --filter 'AIDecisionCoverage/*' --filter 'CastorContinuation/*' --filter 'RuntimeContinuation/*' --filter 'RuntimeBuildingOrderSaveLoad/*' --filter 'JavaScriptCompatibility/*' --filter 'JavaScriptIntegration/*' --filter 'JavaScriptSimulation/*' --filter 'JavaScriptLifecycle/*' --filter 'AISavePortability/*' --filter 'TeamStatsSave/*' --filter 'SavegameSafety/*' --filter 'TournamentCompatibility/*' --filter 'CortexNetCoverage/*' --filter 'NetSendOrderDecode/*' --filter 'Maxima.Continuation/*' --filter 'Maxima.Lifecycle/*' --filter 'Maxima.Diagnostics/*' --filter 'Maxima.Economy/*' --filter 'TurnEngineHarness/the committed*' --no-display --verbose --junit artifacts/ai-continuation/committed.xml
python3 -m unittest discover -s test -p test_check_sim_revision.py -v
python3 test/check_sim_revision.py --base origin/master
```

The seven Python version-contract tests and simulation-version check pass. Coverage includes malformed and authentic legacy records, controller construction/wrapper loading, pending work and cached observations, and 110 checkpoints followed for 256 ticks each with repeated reloads, mixed controllers and shared teams. Original multiplayer setup, seed, orders and checksum trace remain unchanged; only version metadata and the record CRC change.

Linux execution and cross-platform continuation comparison were unavailable locally. Display checks were excluded by `--no-display`. GitHub's lightweight contract checks passed; hosted native/platform matrices were not requested. The compiled provenance identifies the pre-commit dirty source tree whose code was committed without subsequent code changes; the record CRC was subsequently repaired and verified.

[Verification report](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/evidence/ai-save-state-929dafeb7/AIContinuationMergeVerification.txt) · [Logs, JUnit, checkpoint saves, traces and SHA-256 manifest](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/evidence/ai-save-state-929dafeb7/AIContinuationMergeEvidence.zip).
